detail: Create, search, join and leave rooms modelled on sceNpMatching2. A search sees only the rooms of its own title, with each room's external data. Room messages, owner kicks, owner handoff when the owner leaves, and member pushes with each peer's address and P2P port.
note: Upstream work. `KICK_MEMBER` removes a member but does not prevent rejoining.

detail: External and internal room data (only the owner writes it), room flags that searchers see (`SET_ROOM_DATA` which 2), and member data sent with `CREATE_ROOM` and `JOIN_ROOM` and returned in every member entry.
note: External and internal data are upstream work (0.1.0). Room flags and member data are newer, so clients built against 0.1.0 no longer match.

detail: An 8-character code per room (`SET_ROOM_ACCESS`, `JOIN_BY_CODE`, `GET_ROOM_ACCESS`). The room leaves search and the status page, which counts unlisted rooms. A connection that sends too many wrong codes is closed.
note: Protocol 0.4: `HELLO_ACK` flags bit 1 says the server has them. Codes are never logged.

detail: Matching2 room passwords, private slots and join by room ID. A relay-only variant that keeps members' addresses hidden from each other is also wanted.
note: The relay-only variant is not designed yet.

detail: Modelled on sceNpScore: each player's best score is kept, a tie goes to whoever scored first, boards are higher-is-better or lower-is-better, and ranks are read by range or by online ID.
note: Upstream work. Kept in memory: a restart empties every board. Opt-in storage is planned (store-sqlite).

detail: Names are compared case-insensitively. A HELLO with a name held from another address gets ERROR 8 (name taken); from the same address it is the same player reconnecting, and the old connection is closed.
note: No passwords: a name is not authenticated.

detail: sceNpBasic: a friends list (everyone on the same server), presence (online, title, room), invites and join-a-friend, player history and a block list.

detail: A player's P2P socket sends the server a UDP PROBE. The server records the public endpoint and gives each viewer the address that works from where they are: the public one from another network, the LAN address from the same one.

detail: `-relay`, off by default: streams into a player behind a router go through the server, and datagrams go through the server's UDP port when punching does not get through (as with a symmetric NAT).
note: Upstream work. Uses the server's bandwidth; there is no per-player budget yet (net-guardrails).

detail: PROBE and RELAY packets are accepted only from the IP address of the player's TCP connection. A probe's `local_ip` is kept only if it is private, carrier-grade NAT, link-local or the probe's own source. `-udp-any-source` turns the check off.
note: A Podman run is recorded in docker/README.md.

detail: Bounded per-source-IP UDP packet admission shared by probes, relay and invalid traffic, plus aggregate drop-reason counters in /api/stats. The token bucket tracks at most 4096 sources, expires idle entries and rejects new sources at capacity.
